summary: Reports on the IAB workshop on Measuring Network Quality for End-Users, held virtually on 14 to 16 September 2021. It summarizes the topics discussed and the preliminary conclusions drawn. It reflects the views of workshop participants rather than the IAB. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Experts met online to talk about how to tell whether your Internet is good, beyond just speed. This is the write-up of what they said.
